data.title: 轻井泽惠 · 商业街试衣镜前的甜系辣妹姿态
data.description: 榉树购物中心的时尚服装店内，惠身穿米色宽松针织开衫搭配粉格百褶短裙，在全身镜前摆弄单马尾，俏皮吐舌比出V字手势。
data.location: 时尚精品服装店全身镜前
data.action: 一手比着剪刀手贴在颊边，另一手轻扯开衫衣摆，歪头朝着镜子摆出甜心辣妹专属造型
data.lighting: 时尚店铺明亮现代的暖黄嵌灯与射灯，镜面光泽透亮
data.camera: 镜面反射构图，展现青春无敌的时尚活力
data.promptProse: Kei Karuizawa playfully admires her new outfit in front of a floor-to-ceiling mirror inside a trendy boutique at the Keyaki Mall. Wearing a slouchy beige knit cardigan paired with a fashionable pink plaid pleated mini skirt, she poses with a perky peace sign beside her cheek and a cheeky wink. Bright, modern boutique spotlights illuminate her stylish high ponytail and youthful gyaru charm.
data.animaCaption: Posing before the boutique fitting mirror, Kei flashes a cheerful peace sign in her trendy cardigan and plaid skirt.
